summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any tests or repository code, so all verification was by reading only. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with keyboard, click, navigation, and animation handling); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges before width and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style to preserve metadata; the layout resolver Edge docstring documents size, min_size, and fraction without changing arithmetic; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py with __init__.py. Choices: bar position uses the displayed-tab index rather than the full-list find_tab_by_name index, because duplicates before the active tab would otherwise misplace the underline; zero-width labels use min_size 0 and fraction 0 so they resolve to zero cells; the optional sandbox demo was skipped. Unverified: the assumption that rich Style addition preserves meta, and whether the existing underline tests and the new tests pass. Nothing was committed.
